army_rules.name: Pact of Blood
army_rules.rules_text:
Through acts of frenzied violence and unbound savagery, the World Eaters may open a rent in reality, allowing the daemons of Khorne to spill forth from that infernal domain.

When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select BLOOD LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

army_rules.name: Blessings of Khorne
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne. Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires, and the selected Blessing applies until the end of the battle round.

options.name: Unbridled Bloodlust
options.rules_text: This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

options.name: Rage-fuelled Invigoration
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

options.name: Total Carnage
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

options.name: Martial Excellence
options.rules_text: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

options.name: Warp Blades
options.rules_text: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

options.name: Decapitating Strikes
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

rule.name: RELENTLESS RAGE
rule.rules_text: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit from your army makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

enhancements.name: BERZERKER GLAIVE
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: HELM OF BRAZEN IRE
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: FAVOURED OF KHORNE
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. Each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll up to two of the D6 rolled.

enhancements.name: BATTLE-LUST
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. In addition, while the Unbridled Bloodlust Blessing of Khorne is active for your army, add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

stratagems.name: BLOOD OFFERING
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: HACK AND SLASH
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and that made a charge move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: FRENZIED RESILIENCE
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE!
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER or MONSTER model.
stratagems.target: That WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Make a Blessings of Khorne roll and use the results to activate one Blessing of Khorne. Until the end of the battle round, that Blessing of Khorne is active in addition to any other Blessings of Khorne that are currently active.

stratagems.name: APOPLECTIC FRENZY
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a KHORNE BERZERKERS unit from your army is selected to Advance.
stratagems.target: That KHORNE BERZERKERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: BERZERKER'S WRATH
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One KHORNE BERZERKERS unit from your army that can make a surge move as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll a D6 to determine how far models in your unit can move when they make a surge move. Instead, when making a surge move, those models can move up to 8".

rule.name: IDOLS OF KHORNE
rule.rules_text: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active and its effects apply to all WORLD EATERS TITANIC and WORLD EATERS MONSTER units from your army. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.

additional_rules.name: IDOL OF INFINITE RAGE (AURA)
additional_rules.rules_text: While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
additional_rules.activation_hint: Select only while this Idol is active and the receiving JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is in the stated aura range. Idol usage and range are not tracked automatically.

additional_rules.name: IDOL OF BURNING WRATH (AURA)
additional_rules.rules_text: While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

additional_rules.name: IDOL OF BLESSED BLOOD (AURA)
additional_rules.rules_text: While a friendly JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
additional_rules.activation_hint: Select only while this Idol is active and the receiving JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit is in the stated aura range. Idol usage and range are not tracked automatically.

keywords.applies_to: JAKHALS and GOREMONGERS units from your army

enhancements.name: CHOSEN OF THE BLOOD GOD
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Aura abilities.

enhancements.name: BUTCHER LORD
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS INFANTRY model only. The bearer has the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: BRAZEN FORM
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS MONSTER model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: STRATEGIC SLAUGHTER
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three JAKHALS and/or GOREMONGERS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: BLOODY VENGEANCE
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.activation_hint: Select only against the enemy unit that destroyed the friendly MONSTER or TITANIC unit targeted by this Stratagem.

stratagems.name: DRAWN TO THE SLAUGHTER
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One JAKHALS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units.
You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF BRASS IDOLS
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, your unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

options.name: IN THE SHADOW OF BRASS IDOLS - WITHIN IDOL RANGE
options.rules_text: 1CP. Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, after targets are selected. Select for JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS within 6 inches of a friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9 inches of a friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit. Feel No Pain 5+ instead of 6+.

stratagems.name: BLOODTHIRSTY HORDE
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

stratagems.name: FAIL NOT THE BLOOD GOD
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model's unit is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER units, or within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC units, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

options.name: FAIL NOT THE BLOOD GOD - WITHIN IDOL RANGE
options.rules_text: 1CP. Fight phase. Select for a JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit within 6 inches of a friendly WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9 inches of a friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit. Re-roll the Hit roll instead of only rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: BRAZEN IDOL
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS MONSTER or WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select the Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Idols of Khorne ability is active for your unit instead of any other Idols of Khorne ability that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

detachments.name: KHORNE DAEMONKIN

rule.name: BLOOD TITHE
rule.rules_text: Each time a BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend one or more of your BTP to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle.

additional_rules.name: ENRAGED ABJURATION
additional_rules.rules_text: BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
additional_rules.activation_hint: Select only after spending 2BTP to activate this Blood Tithe ability. Blood Tithe points are not tracked automatically.

additional_rules.name: DAEMONIC RAGE
additional_rules.rules_text: Melee weapons equipped by BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have the LANCE ability.
additional_rules.activation_hint: Select only after spending 3BTP to activate this Blood Tithe ability. Blood Tithe points are not tracked automatically.

additional_rules.name: BOON OF BLOOD
additional_rules.rules_text: BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.
additional_rules.activation_hint: Select only after spending 4BTP to activate this Blood Tithe ability. Blood Tithe points are not tracked automatically.

additional_rules.name: MIGHT OF KHORNE
additional_rules.rules_text: BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.

restrictions: You can include BLOOD LEGIONS units in your army.
Incursion: Up to 500 points of BLOOD LEGIONS units.
Strike Force: Up to 1000 points of BLOOD LEGIONS units.
Onslaught: Up to 1500 points of BLOOD LEGIONS units.
No BLOOD LEGIONS model from your army can be your WARLORD.

enhancements.name: ICON OF WAR
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. While a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit is within 6" of the bearer, that unit has the Blessings of Khorne ability. If the Might of Khorne ability is active for your army, then while a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

enhancements.name: BLOOD-FORGED ARMOUR
enhancements.rules_text: BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. If the bearer is destroyed, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point.
restrictions: BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS model only.
enhancements.implementation_note: The bearer's 2+ Save is applied. Blood Tithe points on death are not tracked.

enhancements.name: DISCIPLE OF KHORNE
enhancements.rules_text: LORD ON JUGGERNAUT model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability and has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of the WORLD EATERS Faction keyword.

enhancements.name: BLADE OF ENDLESS BLOODSHED
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, do not roll to gain a Blood Tithe point; you automatically gain 1 Blood Tithe point instead.
enhancements.implementation_note: The bearer's melee Attacks, Strength and Damage bonuses are applied. Blood Tithe points are not tracked.

stratagems.name: SUMMONED BY SLAUGHTER
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when the last model in a unit is destroyed, before removing it from play (if that unit is a TRANSPORT, any units embarked within that TRANSPORT model must disembark first).
stratagems.target: One BLOODLETTERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that destroyed model and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, then remove the destroyed model from play.
restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC FURY
stratagems.timing: Start of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in your WORLD EATERS unit have the LANCE ability. If the Daemonic Rage ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase those melee weapons also have the TWIN-LINKED ability.

options.name: DAEMONIC FURY - DAEMONIC RAGE ACTIVE
options.rules_text: 1CP. Start of your Fight phase. Select for a WORLD EATERS unit within 6 inches of the targeted friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit while Daemonic Rage is active. Melee weapons have LANCE and TWIN-LINKED.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY SKULL
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit from your army has fought, and one or more enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.target: That BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.effect: You gain D3BTP and you can then spend one or more BTP you have to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities.

stratagems.name: BLESSING OF BURNING BLOOD
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 6" of a friendly WORLD EATERS unit that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If the Boon of Blood ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

options.name: BLESSING OF BURNING BLOOD - BOON OF BLOOD ACTIVE
options.rules_text: 1CP. Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, after targets are selected. Select for the attacked WORLD EATERS unit within 6 inches of the targeted friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit while Boon of Blood is active. Models have a 4+ invulnerable save instead of 5+.

stratagems.name: DAEMONTIDE
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6" of your unit. One destroyed MOUNTED model, up to D3 destroyed BEAST models, or up to D6 destroyed INFANTRY models are returned to that BLOOD LEGIONS unit with their full wounds remaining.
restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER models to Attached units.

stratagems.name: MURDER-CALL
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One BLOOD LEGIONS unit from your army that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: BRAZEN FURY
rule.rules_text: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED units from your army have the following ability: Brazen Fury: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was destroyed as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6". That surge move is a Brazen Fury move.

enhancements.name: MALICIOUS VIGOUR
enhancements.rules_text: SLAUGHTERBOUND model only. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Brazen Fury move, it is treated as having rolled a 6 for the distance the unit can be moved.

enhancements.name: KILLING CLARITY
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: FRENZIED FOCUS
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

enhancements.name: VIOLENT DEMISE
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS DAEMON model only. The bearer's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 2+ instead of on a 6. In addition, the bearer has the Deadly Demise D3+1 ability, instead of the Deadly Demise D3 ability.

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC RESISTANCE
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC STRENGTH
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to an enemy model, if your unit has the EIGHTBOUND keyword and that enemy model is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack. If your unit has the EXALTED EIGHTBOUND keyword and that enemy model is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack instead.

stratagems.name: IMMORTAL FURY
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: RAPID MANIFESTATION
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: WARP STALKERS
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless that move was a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: HORRIFYING VIOLENCE
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Command phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

rule.name: RUSH TO THE FRAY
rule.rules_text: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, add 1 to Charge rolls made for that unit and that unit's melee weapons have the LANCE ability.

options.name: RUSH TO THE FRAY - DISEMBARKED THIS TURN
options.rules_text: Select after this unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn. Its melee weapons have LANCE. The +1 Charge roll is not applied by the combat simulation.

rule.implementation_note: Use the Disembarked This Turn selection for LANCE. The Charge bonus is not automated.

enhancements.name: MURDEROUS ONSLAUGHT
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. If the bearer's unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: AGGRESSIVE DEPLOYMENT
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: UNLEASH HELL
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer or, if the bearer is embarked within a TRANSPORT, you can select that TRANSPORT model. Until the end of the phase, after the selected model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: INFERNAL INFUSION
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS PURSUIT OF VIOLENCE
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit from your army and one friendly TRANSPORT that it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.name: SMASH THROUGH
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: One WORLD EATERS unit embarked within your RHINO can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your RHINO and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: FULL-THROTTLE ASSAULT
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 1806) for that disembarkation.

stratagems.name: UNRELENTING ADVANCE
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to 6".
restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.

stratagems.name: FURY UNLEASHED
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: One KHORNE BERZERKERS unit embarked within your model can make a disembark move and then make a surge move of up to D6+2".
restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.

detachments.name: BRAZEN ENGINES

rule.name: RAMPAGING TERRORS
rule.rules_text: Friendly DAEMON VEHICLE units have the following ability: Terror of Khorne: At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

restrictions: This detachment has the ONSLAUGHT tag and cannot be taken with another ONSLAUGHT detachment.

enhancements.name: TALONS OF BUTCHERY
enhancements.rules_text: MAULERFIEND unit only. This unit's Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].

enhancements.name: MURDER-FORGED ENTITY
enhancements.rules_text: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE unit only. This unit has DAEMON.
